releaseNotes: Smart Reminder repair: the screen lights on over the lock screen and notification/ringtone arrive, while a separate transparent wake-only activity prevents My Diary from opening automatically. A normal notification tap still opens My Diary; exact alarm scheduling, Snooze, Done, stored reminders, notes, photos, PIN data, and app identity remain unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: Diary features and design updated online. Local notes and photos remain on this device.
